title: Wonderful Experience – Highly Recommended!
text:
We had a fantastic experience on this tour in Barcelona! Everything was well organized, and it was a great way to discover the city and enjoy its unique atmosphere. The experience was enjoyable, informative, and memorable from beginning to end. The tour was a perfect opportunity to learn more about Barcelona, appreciate its beauty, and make the most of our time there.
I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona. It was a wonderful experience, and I would happily do it again!
author: Z1667HUaliced

title: See Barcelona on Bike!
text: We took a new route through the Old Town and the coast of Barcelona. Jonas was wonderful. Saw the cool historic sites and the ‘new Barcelona’ waterfront. Knowledgeable and helpful. Not rushed. The store was also extremely accommodating and kind!
author: Lisa M

title: Perfect Bike Tour – Highly Recommended!
text:
Amazing experience! Everything went perfectly, starting from the booking process, which was quick and easy, to the bike pick-up and the entire tour.
The bikes were brand new and very comfortable, making the ride really enjoyable and relaxing. A special thanks to our guide, Samuele, who was excellent — professional, friendly, and very clear in his explanations, all in Italian.
We also really appreciated that they took so many group photos during the tour, a lovely memory to take home!
Highly recommended! 🚴‍♀️✨
author: 144matilden

title: Fun day touring touring the city on bikes
text:
We had the best morning on a bike tour. Our guide Samuele was great. He was very knowledgeable about the city, the bike routes and was just a fun guy to be around. The bike route we took was super easy and we covered alot of sites. Just a really fun day.
Kostiantyn helped us with our booking and he was super accommodating.
Would definitely recommend Bikes and Tours Barcelona!
author: ainsleycampbellsmith

title: Super fun bike tour with enthusiastic guide!
text: Last Monday we did the bike tour through Barcelona with guide Marijn. The weather was lovely and we saw all kinds of beautiful locations in Barcelona. During the stops, our guide enthusiastically told us about the area and sights. Educational and inspiring, definitely worth repeating!!
author: MC D

title: Enthusiasm
text: Immediately after arrival first did a bike tour to get to know the city. Marijn was called the guide and she guided us in a very enthusiastic way along various sights. And also guides us safely past traffic 😅. Highly recommended to do the bike tour with her.

title: Fabulous time biking around Barcelona!
text: I had a fabulous time biking around Barcelona! My guide, Britt, went at a perfect pace and kept everyone safe. There were plenty of stops to take in the views and take photos - and she explained some of the history and meaning as well. This is a great way to experience the city!
author: betsy_cossette

title: Fantastic experience 🚲😍
text:
It was such a pleasant and interesting experience 🚲 Bikes were comfortable, really easy and relaxing ride through all the major parts of the city. Managers at the beginning were soo nice and welcoming, and of course our guide was actually really knowledgeable about the history and architecture, all the information was very interesting☺️
 Highly recommended!
author: H4459ZG_

title: Amazing tour
text:
We happened to be just the two of us and were very happy with the tour. Our female guide was very kind. Thank you for the wonderful experience. I could have kept riding all day.
Barcelona is a fantastic city to explore by bike - beautiful routes, a great atmosphere, and plenty to see along the way.
Amazing!
